entries.mechanism: Reverified on PolicyEngine 4.18.9, PolicyEngine-US 1.767.3, and PolicyEngine-Core 3.30.3. The exact-household signature and explicit K-12 counterfactual reproduce the mechanism: PolicyEngine excludes all earnings of an imputed K-12 member age 17 or younger without requiring the co-resident-parent or parental-control condition in 7 CFR 273.9(c)(7). The sole minor is a valid household under 273.1(a)(1), but wages count under 273.9(b)(1)(i), so Axiom correctly fails the income gate and returns zero benefit.
